origin.rule: One extraction per DISTINCT sha256, not one per carrying archive - the same rule tools/variants.py applies to tables. Byte-identical copies are ONE version, extracted under the HIGHEST-ranked archive that carries those bytes with the others listed in `alsoIn`. A version whose bytes are already extracted as a loose client-root binary is not extracted twice either; it is recorded against that binary in `alsoInArchives`. Chain rank is position in tools/inventory.discover_archives(), the same loader order every other layer here uses.
